skills.summary: Checks an agent-drafted moderation recommendation against its case record so the allegation stays unproven and authority stays human.
triggers: Draft or review a moderation recommendation
prerequisites: A case record with a named human decision maker and appeal route
stopping_conditions: Two failed fix rounds: hand to the trust-and-safety lead
skills.output_contract: JSON: ok, violations with rule, location and message, and the authority line.
failure_states: Phrase rules can miss reworded verdicts
